intro.title: TanStack Query Basics
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React application that fetches and displays a list of posts from a mock API. You'll learn the core concept of server-state management using TanStack Query, which simplifies data fetching, caching, and synchronization. The main technologies involved are React for the UI, JavaScript for logic, and TanStack Query's useQuery hook to handle API calls. By the end, you'll understand how to efficiently load and show data in your components without manual state management for loading and error states.
intro.usecase: TanStack Query is essential for building modern, data-driven web applications that require efficient server-state management. You'll use it in product dashboards to fetch and display real-time analytics, in e-commerce sites to load product listings and user carts, and in social media feeds to handle pagination and live updates. This pattern prevents manual loading states and refetching logic, letting you focus on building responsive UIs that feel instant to users.
